mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP1A2 enzymes, potentially increasing ciprofloxacin levels; turmeric also has antiplatelet properties that may increase bleeding risk with fluoroquinolones.
action: Monitor for increased ciprofloxacin adverse effects (tendinitis, QT prolongation, photosensitivity); consider spacing doses or selecting alternative therapy if high-dose turmeric supplementation is concurrent.
